request.source:
-- 只读检查断点界面、停止现场、候选地址及目标参数；不运行游戏。
local context = debug_getCurrentContextTable(false)
local list = nil
local dialog = false
for index = 0, getFormCount() - 1 do
    local form = getForm(index)
    if form.ClassName == 'TfrmBreakpointlist' then
        assert(list == nil, 'Multiple breakpoint lists')
        list = form
    elseif form.ClassName == 'TfrmBreakpointCondition' then dialog = true end
end
local view = list and list.findComponentByName('ListView1')
local refresh = list and list.findComponentByName('Timer1')
local menu = list and list.findComponentByName('miSetCondition')
local existing = {}
for _, address in ipairs(debug_getBreakpointList() or {}) do existing[#existing+1] = string.format('%X', address) end
return {
    pid=getOpenedProcessID(), stopped=type(context)=='table', debugging=debug_isDebugging(),
    rip=type(context)=='table' and string.format('%X', context.RIP) or '',
    conditionDialogOpen=dialog, existingBreakpoints=existing,
    ui={breakpointList=list~=nil, listView=view~=nil,
        refreshEvent=refresh~=nil and type(refresh.OnTimer)=='function',
        conditionMenu=menu~=nil,
        openListMenu=getMemoryViewForm().findComponentByName('Breakpointlist1')~=nil,
        timerApi=type(createTimer)=='function', tickApi=type(getTickCount)=='function'},
    addInstruction=disassemble(getAddress('victoria3.exe+11FD93B')),
    removeInstruction=disassemble(getAddress('victoria3.exe+11FAF69')),
    goodsId=readInteger(0x3A4012E4A60+0x10), goodsName=readString(0x3A4012E4A60+0x18,5,false),
    capacity1D58=readInteger(0x3A484D9F8B8), capacity1D5C=readInteger(0x3A484D9F8BC),
}
